name: AviatorJob
summary: Aviation recruiting platform whose AI verifies licences, checks type ratings, scores candidates and runs a chatbot that pre-qualifies applicants around the clock.
paragraphs: Aviation recruiting platform whose AI verifies licences, checks type ratings, scores candidates and runs a chatbot that pre-qualifies applicants around the clock.
whyItMatters: Offered as full-service, in-house subscription or hybrid, so a small operator can start with the portal and only pay agency rates for hard-to-fill seats.
